summary.text: A secret Central Continent organization of Gu Immortals, named when Ying Wu Xie borrows Immortal Gu from its members.

claims.text: In Ming Tang valley, the demonic path Gu Immortal Gong Sun Liang, called Unmoving Mountain, receives a request from the organization’s boss to borrow his Immortal Gu. After a near-fatal escape from Central Continent righteous path pursuit, a mysterious man saved him and led him into that organization, which is called Defy. Members are identified with numbers and stay mysterious; Gong Sun Liang credits Defy with help that kept him from capture by the ten great sects. Codename marks join time and status, and Boss sits at the top as the person who created Defy.

Two sword path Gu Immortals of Great Heavenly Sword Sect, Miao Jun and Miao Yue, receive the same boss request and refuse. They joined Defy hoping for help leaving Immortal Crane Sect vassal status, did not get that help, and will not lend Immortal Gu.

Defy was created by Shadow Sect. Under Heavenly Court rule, the ten great ancient sects hold most Central Continent resources; smaller forces form short-lived alliances that the ten sects break or that collapse from inside conflict. Shadow Sect secretly created Defy, selected members carefully, and treated the project as a casual move with low expectations, because those members were neither otherworldly demons nor fate escapees suited to resist heaven’s will. After Shadow Sect’s later setback, Ying Wu Xie has to use Defy; most members make excuses when asked to lend Immortal Gu, member identities stay secret from one another, and enforcement is not strict. Only unsupported demonic path Gu Immortals such as Gong Sun Liang depend on Defy enough that he risks the loan.

Fairy Zi Wei states that the original owner of Hu Immortal blessed land, Hu Immortal, was a member of Defy. Feng Jin Huang already knows Defy as a powerful undercover Central Continent force formed from a secret alliance of Gu Immortals, hidden longer than most rebel groups against the ten great ancient sects, with members who do not know each other’s identities and address one another by number codes. On the surface Hu Immortal looked like a lone immortal who obtained Dang Hun Mountain by chance; Zi Wei reads Defy as helping from behind the scenes, and she treats Fang Yuan as closely connected to Defy even when she cannot settle whether he is a member.

Ying Wu Xie inherits remnant Shadow Sect force and acts as boss of Defy while trying to gather immortal materials through it. Heavenly Court Gu Immortals ambush and capture Gong Sun Liang in Ming Tang valley; his call for help throws Defy into turbulence, other members hide and cut contact, and most Defy members are Gu Immortals suppressed or excluded by the ten great ancient sects.

Shadow Sect created a concealed immortal formation as a future Defy base camp, gathered Gu Immortals unhappy with the ten great ancient sects into that loose secret organization known as Defy, treated Defy as a Shadow Sect branch similar to Zombie Alliance, and lost it when Fairy Zi Wei completely eradicated Defy.
